format: Westwood FNT little-endian offset tables; low nibble is left/even pixel, high nibble is right/odd pixel; row stride ceil(width/2)
notes: Glyph advance is width + mutable g_fontCharOffset, initially -1. Preserve native layout and wrapping even when replacing glyph shape with scalable text.
unusedLines place the glyph vertically; only usedLines rows are stored. Pixel nibbles are palette/remap codes, not fixed RGB.
NEW10P.FNT and STD3P.FNT are supplied but not selected by Font_Init in this build.
